name: The Farm
description: In which the participants, accustomed to the comforts and charms of big city life, will have to survive in conditions they have not known before. to grow and sleep only when their duties allow it. In addition, duels for survival, as well as tasks that will require them to make difficult decisions, not always in accordance with their nature. In order to survive and win the program, the inhabitants of the Farm will have to cooperate with each other, test your survival instinct and strength of character. I will be alliances, quarrels, intrigues, but also friendships, and maybe even love? Every week one participant will say goodbye to the Farm, and ultimately only one will win the title of Super Farmer and 100,000 zlotys! Marcelina Zawadzka and Ilona Krawczyńska will set off on an adventure full of challenges, who from the very first day will try to help Farmers on their way to victory!
